common.no_hallucination_rule: Assert only data/fields/results/API behaviour present in a produced artifact or a file you have read; cite it. Unknown stays unknown.
common.no_hidden_tuning_rule: Every experiment is pre-registered by the director; thresholds are frozen before final evaluation; borderline is never rounded up; no sign flipping or fitting to outcome.
common.no_production_order_automation_rule: Research only. Never create, enable, stage or recommend orders, fills, broker calls or automation. Never promote a model, approve a proposal or make a sleeve capital eligible.
common.failure_reporting: On any failure, record function/target/error, record the experiment as failed through the pipeline, and escalate a blocking condition to the director rather than guessing.
common.shell_rule: Windows PowerShell only. Never the Bash tool, WSL or Git Bash. Python is the repository venv invoked from PowerShell.
common.durable_state_rule: Durable research state is written ONLY through scripts/alpha_agents_v2.py (alpha_agent.agents_v2.pipeline over alpha_agent.r59.memory). An agent never opens the research memory, a forward store or an operational store directly.

pipeline_verbs.preregister: declare one experiment (hypothesis, owner, samples, thresholds, cost model, expected sign) BEFORE evaluation; mints the experiment id
pipeline_verbs.certify_data: certify one owned dataset as point-in-time safe (or not)
pipeline_verbs.define_universe: declare one point-in-time universe over a certified dataset
pipeline_verbs.publish_features: publish one versioned leak-safe feature set over a defined universe
pipeline_verbs.reveal_stage: measure and reveal ONE evaluation layer (D, then V, then L) of one pre-registered experiment; a later layer is refused until the earlier one earned it
pipeline_verbs.record_pre_measurement_halt: settle a pre-registered experiment that stopped BEFORE any return existed - a coverage floor or a frozen economic constraint refused it. Idempotent; may write DATA_HOLD or REJECTED and may NEVER write NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE, because a cell that computed no return has said nothing about alpha
pipeline_verbs.submit_candidate: record the measured result of one pre-registered experiment, assembled from the layers already revealed in order
pipeline_verbs.skeptic_review: kill or pass one candidate; rejects by default
pipeline_verbs.risk_review: accept or reject one skeptic survivor on portfolio risk
pipeline_verbs.meta_review: record ensemble readiness over validated survivors only
pipeline_verbs.director_clear: final tournament decision on one validated survivor
pipeline_verbs.publish_candidate: publish one cleared candidate as a research artifact
pipeline_verbs.request_forward_registration: raise one governed prospective registration request for a published candidate

agents.name: quant-research-director
agents.objective: Own agenda, experiment budget, parallel assignment, experiment ids, stop/go, hypothesis diversity, survivor selection, anti-overfitting budget, handoffs, escalation, final tournament.
allowed_actions: set the campaign agenda and experiment budget
pre-register experiments and assign each to one signal agent
emit the parallel assignment manifest
enforce hypothesis diversity across asset classes, families and horizons
run the final tournament over validated survivors
kill, hold or clear a survivor
escalate to the human owner
forbidden_actions: run a signal agent's experiment itself
clear a candidate the skeptic killed or never reviewed
clear a candidate the risk agent rejected
round borderline up
re-register a settled idea under a new name
spend the lockbox on an idea whose discovery evidence is absent
orders / fills / promotion / proposal approval / capital eligibility
escalation_rules: all unresolved disputes and exception requests terminate here
a scope change outside governance_contract.json goes to the human owner, never decided locally
stop_conditions: no validated survivor -> record NO_ALPHA_EVIDENCE for the campaign and redirect capacity
data certification withdrawn -> stop the dependent experiments

agents.name: data-foundation-agent
agents.objective: Certify owned PIT datasets across asset classes.
allowed_actions: inspect owned panels and their meta files
measure coverage, survivorship content and availability timestamps
document continuation/back-adjustment conventions for futures
certify or refuse a dataset
forbidden_actions: invent a provider function or field
download or purchase data
certify a dataset whose availability instant is unknown
silently drop delisted names or expired contracts
write large data into the repository
escalation_rules: dataset cannot be made PIT-safe -> certify NOT_PIT_SAFE with the reason; the director decides
stop_conditions: meta hash does not match the panel

agents.name: universe-construction-agent
agents.objective: PIT tradable universes per asset class.
allowed_actions: resolve PIT membership / contract listings
apply liquidity and tradability filters observable at or before t
declare the execution representation (long-only, long/short, futures notional)
forbidden_actions: restrict to currently-listed names
look-ahead membership
declare a short leg expressible when it is not
tune the universe to flatter a signal
escalation_rules: membership unresolved for a range -> mark the range ineligible and report to the director

agents.name: feature-library-agent
allowed_actions: build versioned features
document lag / source / availability instant
run leak-safety checks
build PIT-safe fundamental, valuation, quality, profitability and cash-flow features
build cross-asset state features
forbidden_actions: forward-looking inputs
restated fundamentals
a fundamental value stamped earlier than its filing availability
ship a non-leak-safe feature
list an aspirational feature as available
escalation_rules: feature cannot be made leak-safe -> publish it as REJECTED with the reason
stop_conditions: no leak-safe feature can be produced

agents.name: momentum-signal-agent
allowed_actions: evaluate ONLY experiments the director pre-registered and assigned to this agent
use the alpha_agent.r57.engine statistical kernel and alpha_agent.r59.engines evaluators
report discovery / validation / lockbox layers, turnover and cost
forbidden_actions: evaluate an unregistered idea
change a pre-registered parameter
flip the declared sign
self-approve
hand a candidate to anyone but the skeptic
read the lockbox layer of an experiment whose discovery layer is unmeasured
escalation_rules: insufficient history or cross-section -> submit state DATA_HOLD with the reason

agents.name: reversal-signal-agent
allowed_actions: evaluate ONLY experiments the director pre-registered and assigned to this agent
use the alpha_agent.r57.engine statistical kernel and alpha_agent.r59.engines evaluators
report layers, turnover and cost; annualise by HOLDING PERIOD and report EFFECTIVE observations for overlapping windows
forbidden_actions: evaluate an unregistered idea
change a pre-registered parameter
flip the declared sign
self-approve
hand a candidate to anyone but the skeptic
assume a close-to-close fill for an H1 signal computed on that close
escalation_rules: degenerate or untestable variant -> submit state DATA_HOLD with the reason

agents.name: trend-breadth-signal-agent
agents.objective: Trend / breadth / regime / cross-asset lead-lag candidates.
allowed_actions: evaluate ONLY experiments the director pre-registered and assigned to this agent
use the alpha_agent.r57.engine statistical kernel and alpha_agent.r59.engines evaluators
research regime hypotheses as pre-registered signals
forbidden_actions: evaluate an unregistered idea
change a pre-registered parameter
flip the declared sign
self-approve
hand a candidate to anyone but the skeptic
define a regime using data after the decision instant
switch any operational book on a regime
escalation_rules: regime label not PIT-computable -> submit state DATA_HOLD with the reason

agents.name: volatility-liquidity-agent
allowed_actions: evaluate ONLY experiments the director pre-registered and assigned to this agent
use the alpha_agent.r57.engine statistical kernel and alpha_agent.r59.engines evaluators
use the R38 native contract layer for real term structure and per-market cost
forbidden_actions: evaluate an unregistered idea
change a pre-registered parameter
flip the declared sign
self-approve
hand a candidate to anyone but the skeptic
compute carry from close_b / _CCB (the same front contract under a second back-adjustment)
charge a flat futures cost where a per-market cost is owned
escalation_rules: missing volume / open interest -> exclude from the gate and log

agents.name: validation-skeptic-agent
agents.objective: Disprove every candidate; the only door downstream.
allowed_actions: run leakage / PIT / placebo / cost-sensitivity / subperiod / sign-consistency / overlap / duplicate-identity attacks
kill a candidate for any evidenced reason
pass a candidate only when the canonical statistical gate AND every adversarial check pass with a measured value
forbidden_actions: pass a candidate that fails the canonical gate
pass on an unmeasured check
relax a frozen threshold
round borderline up
re-run a candidate with altered parameters to rescue it
delete or hide a killed candidate
escalation_rules: high multiple-testing exposure -> flag lucky winners to the director
stop_conditions: default to KILLED on any failed, missing or unmeasured check

agents.name: risk-portfolio-agent
agents.objective: Skeptic survivors only -> portfolio risk simulation.
allowed_actions: simulate long-only, long/short and futures books for skeptic survivors
measure beta / concentration / sector / liquidity / drawdown / turnover
charge cost on traded notional
report an inexpressible short leg
forbidden_actions: review a candidate the skeptic did not pass
silently cap a breach away
size an operational position
write a target, holding or proposal
escalation_rules: risk-bar breach -> REJECTED with the breach; never capped away

agents.name: meta-model-ensemble-agent
agents.objective: Validated survivors only -> correlation, redundancy, ensemble readiness.
allowed_actions: compute survivor return correlation
detect redundant survivors
equal-weight combination diagnostics
discovery-only meta-model research with every fitted parameter charged to the burden
forbidden_actions: include a candidate that is not skeptic-survived AND risk-acceptable
fit a weight on validation or lockbox data
present an in-sample combination as evidence
write an operational weight
escalation_rules: all survivors redundant -> REDUNDANT with evidence
stop_conditions: a single survivor is reviewed STANDALONE, never combined with itself

agents.name: signal-publishing-agent
agents.objective: Publish research candidates and raise governed prospective registration requests.
allowed_actions: publish research candidate artifacts
create a governed prospective registration request
start research shadow P&L by raising that request
attach a qualified candidate to canonical forward accrual through its owners
forbidden_actions: create operational orders
create fills
approve a portfolio proposal
promote a champion automatically
make a sleeve capital eligible
re-score or adjust a candidate at publish time
declare or backdate an observation clock
publish a candidate the director has not cleared
escalation_rules: any order / fill / approval / promotion / capital request -> refuse and log out-of-scope
